description: Where a Solana transaction this server sent stands: landed, failed (nothing moved), dropped (its blockhash expired unseen, nothing moved, safe to send again) or pending. Pass the blockhash a send returned so a dropped one can be told apart. Waits at most timeoutMs (default: one read). Read only.

timeoutMs.description: Keep checking up to this long, in ms (default 0: read once).

name: gloam_solana_tx_status
title: Solana transaction status
